$comment: Inputs for tools/season_from_research.py: maps the 2003 entrants to pack teams, colours and tracks. Rules, car profiles, engines and the Dunlop tyre come from the era base (bases/dtm-era3/gen.json); 2003 is the base's mother template, so it changes only the qualifying (patches/regulations.json). Team colours are first estimates from the main sponsor's colours, not yet checked against 2003 photos. Teams on year-old 2002 cars get less development headroom (potential 3, wishlist C4 and D7). Adria, Donington and the Lausitz long course are traced into the era base (bases/dtm-era3/track_specs) with 2003's laps and tyre wear.
title: DTM 2003 - Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters

Vodafone AMG-Mercedes.history: Run by HWA from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. Bernd Schneider won the 2000 and 2001 titles. Car #4 is entered as Express-Service AMG-Mercedes.

AMG-Mercedes.history: The second HWA car pair from Affalterbach. Marcel Fässler and Jean Alesi drive the 2003 CLK.

Hasseröder Abt-Audi.history: Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run the Abt-Audi TT-R since 2000. Laurent Aïello won the 2002 title with the team.

PlayStation 2 Red Bull Abt-Audi.history: The second Abt Sportsline car pair from Kempten. Mattias Ekström is in his third DTM season.

S line Audi Junior Team.history: Abt's third team, backed by Audi. Two young drivers race year-old 2002 TT-Rs.

OPC Team Holzer.history: One of three Opel teams. Runs the 2003 Astra V8 Coupé for Manuel Reuter and Alain Menu.

OPC Team Phoenix.history: Ernst Moser's team from Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Runs the 2003 Astra V8 Coupé for Opel.

OPC Euroteam.history: The third Opel team. Runs year-old 2002 Astras.

Original-Teile AMG-Mercedes.history: Ingmar Persson's team. Runs three year-old 2002 CLKs. Car #20 is entered as ARTA AMG-Mercedes.

Service 24h AMG-Mercedes.history: Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Runs year-old 2002 CLKs.

track_overrides.$comment: 2003 race laps (research/calendar.csv, mostly derived from distance and lap length). tyre_wear_mult is the base's 2012 value scaled by 2012 laps / 2003 laps, so a stint keeps the same share of the race and two stops stay the normal strategy. Not yet simulated.
